stock.description: Finet Group Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise, delivering a broad spectrum of financial information services, advertising and investor relations solutions, and technology support to both corporate and individual clientele throughout Hong Kong and mainland China. The company's activities are structured across four primary divisions: Financial Information, Advertising and Investor Relationship Services; Securities; Money Lending; and Property Investment. Its comprehensive service offering further includes branding and communications development, online marketing, brokerage, underwriting, and asset management expertise, capital lending, video production, data hosting, financial public relations, and enhanced telecommunications services. Additionally, Finet Group oversees the creation and broadcast of programs via its FinTV brand and maintains a portfolio of property investments. Founded in 1998, the company is based in Wanchai, Hong Kong, and is a part of Maxx Capital International Limited.
